purpose: 展示普通投影和分组聚合的真实排序、HAVING 后排序、LIMIT 0 及 CLI/execute 一致结果
output:
DATA_DIR=/tmp/olap-turbo-demo-normal-sclvm59i/data

=== stable numeric ranking with LIMIT ===
QUERY SELECT id, v FROM proj ORDER BY v ASC, id ASC LIMIT 4
CLI exit_code=0
CLI stdout={"columns":["id","v"],"rows":[[4,-0.50],[1,1],[2,1],[3,2.5]],"row_count":4}
EXECUTE row_count=4 matches CLI

=== raw-text DESC with a second ASC key ===
QUERY SELECT id, text FROM proj ORDER BY text DESC, id ASC LIMIT 3
CLI exit_code=0
CLI stdout={"columns":["id","text"],"rows":[[3,"apple"],[1,"a"],[6,"Z"]],"row_count":3}
EXECUTE row_count=3 matches CLI

=== group HAVING before ORDER BY and LIMIT ===
QUERY SELECT g, count(*), sum(v) FROM groups GROUP BY g HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY sum(v) ASC LIMIT 1
CLI exit_code=0
CLI stdout={"columns":["g","count(*)","sum(v)"],"rows":[["a",3,4.5]],"row_count":1}
EXECUTE row_count=1 matches CLI

=== LIMIT 0 preserves result columns ===
QUERY SELECT id, v FROM proj ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 0
CLI exit_code=0
CLI stdout={"columns":["id","v"],"rows":[],"row_count":0}
EXECUTE row_count=0 matches CLI
